knowledge:
- key_parameters: N=The target number of cells to subsample/sketch ;; seed=Integer seed propagated to Python for reproducibility ;; mat=Matrix of coordinates (e.g., PCA) used to calculate Hausdorff distance ;; Nvec=Vector of sketch sizes to evaluate in diagnostic plots ;; Nrep=Number of bootstrap replicates for each sketch size ;; methods=Subsampling methods to compare (e.g., "geosketch", "uniform") ;; idx=Named list of indices representing the subsamples for composition comparison ;; column=Column name in colData containing cell type labels
- alternatives: scsampler()=An alternative subsampling method calling the scSampler python package for fast diversity-preserving subsampling ;; uniform=Uniform random subsampling, used as a baseline comparison in diagnostic plots
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing very large single-cell datasets where computational resources are limited, or when wanting to preserve rare cell types by subsampling densely populated regions more aggressively than sparsely populated ones.
- pitfalls: Unlike PCA, for t-SNE and UMAP, the projected coordinates of sketched cells themselves may not be identical to their original coordinates in the embedding unless specific projection parameters (like k=1 in t-SNE projection) are used ;; If scaling features before PCA (doscale = TRUE), standard deviations across the sketched cells must be calculated and used for scaling the full dataset ;; Python environment setup via basilisk can take time during the first run to build the conda/virtual environment.

workflows.name: single_cell_sketching_and_projection
workflows.intent: Subsample a large single-cell dataset using geometric sketching, evaluate the subsample quality, and project the full dataset onto the sketched PCA, t-SNE, UMAP, and cluster spaces.
input: pbmc3k (SingleCellExperiment object containing log-normalized counts and PCA reduced dimensions)
workflows.stages: 1. Subsample cells using geosketch ;; 2. Compare cell type composition between full and sketched datasets ;; 3. Evaluate subsampling quality using Hausdorff distance ;; 4. Perform PCA on sketched cells and project full dataset ;; 5. Perform t-SNE on sketched cells and project full dataset ;; 6. Perform UMAP on sketched cells and project full dataset ;; 7. Cluster sketched cells and predict labels for all cells using k-nearest neighbors
workflows.code:
idx800gs <- geosketch(reducedDim(pbmc3k, "PCA"), 
                      N = 800, seed = 123)

compareCompositionPlot(colData(pbmc3k), 
                       idx = list(geosketch = idx800gs), 
                       column = "labels_main")

set.seed(123)
hausdorffDistPlot(mat = reducedDim(pbmc3k, "PCA"), 
                  Nvec = c(400, 800, 2000),
                  Nrep = 3, methods = c("geosketch", "uniform"))

pbmc3k$sketched <- seq_len(ncol(pbmc3k)) %in% idx800gs
dec_sketched <- modelGeneVar(pbmc3k[, pbmc3k$sketched])
top_hvgs_sketched <- getTopHVGs(dec_sketched, n = 2000)

set.seed(123)
doscale <- FALSE
pbmc3k_sketched <- pbmc3k[, pbmc3k$sketched]
pca <- calculatePCA(pbmc3k_sketched, ncomponents = 30, 
                    subset_row = top_hvgs_sketched, 
                    scale = doscale)
projection <- pca
rotation <- attr(pca, "rotation")
centers <- rowMeans(assay(pbmc3k_sketched[top_hvgs_sketched, ],
                          "logcounts"))
pca <- scale(t(assay(pbmc3k[names(centers), ], "logcounts")), center = centers, 
             scale = doscale) %*% rotation
reducedDim(pbmc3k, "PCA_sketch") <- as.matrix(pca)

tsne <- fitsne(
    reducedDim(pbmc3k[, pbmc3k$sketched], "PCA_sketch"), 
    n_jobs = 2L, random_state = 123L,
    perplexity = 30, n_components = 2L, 
    pca = FALSE)
proj <- project(
    x = tsne, 
    new = reducedDim(pbmc3k, "PCA_sketch"), 
    old = reducedDim(pbmc3k[, pbmc3k$sketched], "PCA_sketch"),
    perplexity = 30, k = 1L)
rownames(proj) <- colnames(pbmc3k)
reducedDim(pbmc3k, "TSNE_sketch") <- proj

umap <- umap(
    X = reducedDim(pbmc3k[, pbmc3k$sketched], "PCA_sketch"), 
    n_components = 2, n_neighbors = 50,
    pca = NULL, scale = FALSE, 
    ret_model = TRUE, n_threads = 2L)
proj <- umap_transform(
    X = reducedDim(pbmc3k, "PCA_sketch"), 
    model = umap, 
    n_threads = 2L)
rownames(proj) <- colnames(pbmc3k)
reducedDim(pbmc3k, "UMAP_sketch") <- proj

pca_sketch <- reducedDim(pbmc3k[, pbmc3k$sketched], "PCA_sketch")
clst <- as.character(clusterRows(
    pca_sketch,  
    BLUSPARAM = SNNGraphParam(
        k = 10, type = "rank", 
        num.threads = 2L, 
        cluster.fun = "leiden", 
        cluster.args = list(resolution = 0.15))))
preds <- knn(train = pca_sketch, 
             test = reducedDim(pbmc3k, "PCA_sketch"), 
             cl = clst, k = 1) |> as.character()
pbmc3k$clusters <- preds
